intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Summerville for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from the Old Time Christmas Tree Celebration (December 1) through the Christmas Movie Extravaganza at Sangaree Library (December 23), with the Living Christmas Story (December 3 to 5), PJs with Santa and Christmas on the Square (opening December 5), Breakfast with Santa and the Santa, Snow and Baby Animals visit (December 12) and the Summerville Christmas Parade (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Summerville

  • 11 Christmas events for kids in Summerville
  • 4 free events, including the Old Time Christmas Tree Celebration, the Summerville Christmas Parade, Free Santa Pictures at Tweedle Beedle and the Living Christmas Story
  • Meet Santa: Free Santa Pictures at Tweedle Beedle (Wednesdays, December 2 to 23), PJs with Santa (December 5), Breakfast with Santa (December 12) and Santa, Snow and Baby Animals at Luxe Bar and Bistro (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Old Time Christmas Tree Celebration (December 1) and the Summerville Christmas Parade (December 13)
  • Shows: the Living Christmas Story drive through (December 3 to 5) and Irving Berlin's White Christmas at the Flowertown Players (December 4 to 20)
  • Crafts: Christmas on the Square (December 5 to 19) and the Christmas Ornament Bar (December 20)
  • Season: December 1 to December 23

Planning a bigger day out? Summerville families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Charleston, which covers the Holiday Festival of Lights, A Christmas Carol and the Christmas Parade and Festival.
